basic_info.description: Location, location, location! Welcome home to 565 Duncan St! Located on a coveted and quiet Noe Valley cul-de-sac, this spectacularly remodeled, 4-bedroom, 2 bathroom home boasts a freshly painted interior, freshly installed flooring throughout, new kitchen countertop & kitchen appliances as well as upgraded bathrooms. Up the first staircase, you'll find two connecting bedrooms on the right, a hallway bathroom, the large living and dining rooms as well as the kitchen. Through the living room you'll find patio access that overlooks the peaceful backyard. Up the 2nd staircase, you'll find two more bedrooms and another bathroom. The entry level opens to an entry way, closet and the garage on the right. Through the garage there is access to laundry, a bonus room and a serene backyard. Enjoy your morning coffee or al fresco dinners in the backyard or on the patio. This layout is perfect for a growing family, offering lots of space for all the convenience! With easy access to the vibrant neighborhood amenities, delicious restaurants, Douglass Park, Billy Goat Hill, and an enviable commute, it truly is a rare find - panoramic living at its finest! Don't miss out on this rare opportunity.
